VermilionPortDepartingText:
We're departing
soon. Please get on board.
VermilionPortAskBoardingText:
Welcome to FAST
SHIP S.S.AQUA.

Will you be board-
ing today?
VermilionPortComeAgainText:
We hope to see you
again!
VermilionPortSSTicketText:
{PLAYER} flashed
the S.S.TICKET.

That's it.
Thank you!
VermilionPortNoTicketText:
{PLAYER} tried to
show the S.S. TICKET…

…But no TICKET!

Sorry!
You may board only

if you have an
S.S.TICKET.

The FAST SHIP will
sail on Wednesday.
VermilionPortSailSundayText:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Sunday.
VermilionPortSuperNerdText:
You came from
JOHTO?

I hear many rare
#MON live over there.
